artifacts/api-server/src/jobs/rateLimitC.purpose: Scheduled retention job that deletes expired rate_limit_counters rows in bounded batches behind a grace margin, because the keys hold raw IPs, session tokens and emails; batch size and budget default from admin config and can be overridden per call.

artifacts/api-server/src/lib/activity.ts.purpose: logActivity and the ActivityType union for the per-user activity feed; a best-effort write that logs and swallows errors and never throws, which callers either await or fire and forget.

artifacts/api-server/src/lib/captcha.ts.purpose: Server-side hCaptcha verification shared by every captcha-gated route; with no secret configured it fails closed when NODE_ENV is production and skips with a warning otherwise, a narrower test than isProductionEnv (#700).

artifacts/api-server/src/lib/expandSubje.purpose: Pure, unit-testable transform behind the subject-contraction backfill, expanding the 's contraction and the legacy {He's} token into {has|have} before got/gotten/been/had and {is|are} otherwise.

artifacts/api-server/src/lib/factTokeniz.purpose: Server-owned tokenizer policy: the model, system prompt and post-processing that turn plain-English fact text, and admins' Visual Strategy Override prose, into a personalization template.

artifacts/api-server/src/lib/featureAcce.purpose: The permission chokepoint: the only module that reads the tier feature grid, resolving a principal's features as the union of its tier and admin rows; the can and requireFeature gates fail closed, while the entitlement resolver behind the login payload throws on a database error; also the admin matrix read and write, and the grid revision.

artifacts/api-server/src/lib/globalRateL.purpose: A bounded in-memory Store for express-rate-limit that mirrors MemoryStore's window rotation but caps the tracked keys and evicts oldest-first, so a flood of distinct IPs cannot grow the global limiter into an OOM.

artifacts/api-server/src/lib/ipSalt.ts.purpose: The IP-hash salt and hashIp: resolves the salt with a dev fallback, asserts it is configured in production at boot, and imports nothing that reaches the database so the assertion runs before the DB graph loads.

artifacts/api-server/src/lib/normalizeFa.purpose: The normalize-validate step every new-text template ingress shares, in two variants: the pending-review variant, which the submission, variant and import routes run and which stops at validation, and the storage variant, which the approved-text edit and the legacy-fixture builder run to also derive canonical text, split index and hasPronouns from the final text.

artifacts/api-server/src/lib/objectAcces.purpose: The read-authorization gates for private storage objects: userCanReadObject layers the legacy upload-owner fallback and ACL heal over the object ACL, and userOwnsAiReferenceImage gates AI reference images by their user_ai_images row.

artifacts/api-server/src/lib/objectAcl.t.purpose: Object-storage ACL policy kept as GCS object metadata: set and read the owner-and-visibility policy, and the permission check that lets anyone read a public object and requires the owner for every other access.

artifacts/api-server/src/lib/rateLimit.t.purpose: Express rate-limit middleware factories: the per-instance global /api backstop over BoundedMemoryStore, the DB-backed per-route limiter over checkSharedRateLimit, and the tier-aware fact-submission limiter; windows and maxes default from env, and each factory takes per-call overrides.

artifacts/api-server/src/lib/reactions.t.purpose: The shared reactions mechanism behind fact ratings and meme and comment hearts: writes the polymorphic reactions row, recomputes the target's denormalized counts in the same transaction, plus the Wilson score for fact ratings, and bulk-reads a viewer's reactions for list responses.

artifacts/api-server/src/lib/renderCanon.purpose: Server-side template rendering: the fixed canonical identity used for embeddings and duplicate checks, a personalized render, and the guard keeping that identity out of semantic entities.

artifacts/api-server/src/lib/safeReturnT.purpose: Reduces a caller-supplied returnTo to a same-origin relative path, collapsing absolute, protocol-relative and scheme URLs to / and re-checking after resolution; the one open-redirect rule for the OAuth login and link routes and the dev-admin login.

artifacts/api-server/src/lib/securityHea.purpose: The security-header chain app.ts mounts first on every response: helmet baselines, a route-class-aware report-only CSP, an env-aware frame policy and production-only HSTS; the public cross-origin relaxation lives in cacheHeaders instead.

artifacts/api-server/src/lib/splitTokenI.purpose: Computes the default top/bottom word split stored on each fact for the image wizard's two caption blocks.

artifacts/overhype-me/src/components/Nam.purpose: Navbar name tag where a visitor views and edits the name and pronouns their facts render with, including the AI pronoun suggestion.

artifacts/overhype-me/src/components/com.purpose: Heart toggle for a comment: an optimistic flip reconciled against the heart mutation's response, with anonymous taps routed to login.

artifacts/overhype-me/src/components/fac.purpose: A fact's comment list and composer in two variants, the compact feed form on expanded cards and the hero and the full form on the fact page, with optimistic adds, captcha gating and draft persistence.
Renders a personalized fact with the visitor's name in the brand colour, splitting from the template so a possessive name stays one segment.

artifacts/overhype-me/src/components/mem.purpose: Heart toggle for a meme, sized to sit beside its metadata or as a card overlay: an optimistic flip with rollback on failure, with anonymous taps routed to login.

artifacts/overhype-me/src/hooks/use-pers.purpose: React context and hook holding the visitor's personalization name and pronouns, persisted in localStorage and seeded from share-link parameters.

artifacts/overhype-me/src/lib/infer-pron.purpose: Suggests he/him or she/her from a first name via a common-names table, used to prefill the pronoun choice on Home and Login.

artifacts/overhype-me/src/lib/pronouns.t.purpose: The browser's pronoun-set model: the presets, the default, and serialization of custom five-form sets with their verb plurality.

artifacts/overhype-me/src/lib/render-fac.purpose: Browser-side renderer that substitutes a visitor's name and pronouns into a fact template, plus the legacy non-AI tokenizer and the name-segment split used for highlighting.

artifacts/overhype-me/src/lib/safe-retur.purpose: Client-side twin of the server's getSafeReturnTo: reduces a redirect target to a same-origin path by the same rules, returning null rather than / on a miss so callers can tell no destination from a rejected one.

artifacts/overhype-me/src/pages/Activity.purpose: The /activity page: a signed-in user's paginated feed of status updates on their own submissions and comments, from posting to moderation outcome, read from /api/activity-feed, with mark-all-read.

artifacts/overhype-me/src/pages/admin/co.purpose: Orphaned admin page for the comment moderation queue, with pending and flagged tabs over the admin comment endpoints; /admin/comments redirects to /admin/moderation, which carries its own comment panel, so nothing routes here.

cloudflare/og-router/src/index.ts.purpose: Cloudflare Worker in front of overhype.me: serves known crawlers the OG shell for /m/:slug meme permalinks, passes everyone else through to the SPA, and strips the platform-injected Set-Cookie from meme-image and OG responses, applying long-lived public edge caching only to a 200 the origin did not mark private or no-store.

lib/api-client-react/src/custom-fetch.ts.purpose: The fetch mutator the generated React Query client calls: optional base URL and bearer-token getter for non-browser bundles, header merging, response-type inference, and ApiError and ResponseParseError for failed or unparseable responses.

lib/api-client-react/src/index.ts.purpose: Handwritten barrel of the api-client-react package, re-exporting the generated React Query client and its schema types; codegen leaves this file alone.

lib/api-spec/orval.config.ts.purpose: Orval configuration for the api-spec codegen script: generates the React Query client from openapi.yaml into lib/api-client-react, and the Zod schemas and TypeScript types into lib/api-zod.

lib/api-spec/patch-generated.mjs.purpose: Post-codegen step of the api-spec codegen script: restores the type files orval emits empty, from type-templates or as an empty module, and rewrites the api-zod barrel so generated and handwritten exports coexist.

lib/api-zod/src/resolvedIdentityForms.ts.purpose: Resolves a name and slash-form pronoun set into the form each template token takes, falling back to they/them for a pipe-delimited custom set, and defines the substitution function renderCanonical wraps, with the token-key set the prompt-identity budget is typed against.

lib/api-zod/src/templateGrammar.ts.purpose: The template grammar contract shared by server and browser: the closed token set, the validator, and the deterministic cleanup sequence every new-text ingress write applies.
